brand.name: HUJRAH
brand.description: A contemporary furniture studio and curated sanctuary of architectural objects, bespoke seating, and refined interior pieces crafted for timeless modern spaces.
brand.showroom: Showroom: Al Ain & Dubai Design District (d3), UAE

products.name: Dune Low Modular Sofa
products.materials: High-density foam core, tactile textured bouclé, FSC-certified solid beech frame
products.shortDescription: Low-slung modular sofa with architectural curves and deeply plush textured bouclé upholstery.
products.description: Embodying the quiet restraint of sculptural minimalism, the Dune Modular Sofa balances grounded low proportions with supreme ergonomic comfort. Each module is crafted with an inner solid beech structure and wrapped in stain-resistant tactile bouclé.

specs.Customization: Custom module configurations & bespoke fabrics available

products.name: Palla Sculptural Lounge Chair
products.materials: Curved tubular chrome steel & textured off-white wool bouclé
products.shortDescription: An iconic spherical silhouette nestled within a bent steel framework.
products.description: A striking focal point for conversation areas and modern salons. The Palla chair pairs generous curvilinear cushioning with a gleaming polished chrome undercarriage.

products.name: Roma Honed Travertine Coffee Table
products.materials: Solid Roman beige travertine stone with natural open veining
products.shortDescription: Carved from monolithic blocks of natural honed travertine with softened architectural edges.
products.description: Each Roma table reveals thousands of years of geological formation. Honed to a velvety matte finish, the table top rests securely upon two geometric pedestal plinths.

specs.Finish: Honed Matte with Organic Pores Preserved
specs.Care: Sealed for stain resistance; wipe with damp microfiber

products.name: Komorebi Burl Wood Low Table
products.materials: Californian walnut burl veneer on solid birch core, hand-buffed wax finish
products.shortDescription: Mesmerizing swirl patterns of genuine natural burl root veneer in a cube silhouette.
products.description: A tribute to nature's complex organic tapestry. The Komorebi table showcases dramatic bookmatched root burl veneers, protected with organic hard-wax oil.

products.name: Nara Minimalist Dining Chair
products.materials: Solid Japanese white oak and natural woven Danish paper cord
products.shortDescription: Sculpted solid oak backrest paired with ancestral hand-woven cord seating.
products.description: Engineered with subtle joint work and harmonious proportions, the Nara dining chair provides ergonomic lumbar support for extended evening gatherings.

products.name: Alabaster Dome Table Lamp
products.materials: Solid carved Spanish alabaster stone with spun unlacquered brass accents
products.shortDescription: Translucent mineral stone that casts an ethereal, candle-warm ambient glow.
products.description: Turned on a wood lathe from raw blocks of natural alabaster. When illuminated, the light penetrates the stone to reveal its crystalline subterranean veining.

specs.Cord: 1.8m Braided Linen Wire with In-line Brass Dimmer

products.name: Solitude Asymmetric Wall Mirror
products.materials: Ultra-clear lead-free float glass, brushed champagne aluminum frame
products.shortDescription: Freeform organic outline inspired by desert oasis waterlines.
products.description: An architectural wall sculpture that expands room volume and reflects natural light. Can be mounted vertically or horizontally with included safety brackets.

products.name: Curve Wave 3-Seater Chaise
products.materials: Hardwood structural internal skeleton, layered organic wool batting, chenille weave
products.shortDescription: Sweeping organic curve designed for open-plan villas and contemporary penthouses.
products.description: Seamlessly sculptural from every viewing angle, allowing the sofa to float effortlessly in the center of grand living rooms without wall confinement.

specs.Customization: Left or Right orientation available upon request
specs.Lead Time: Handmade in our Al Ain workshop

products.name: Sculpted Desert Clay Totem
products.materials: Hand-thrown coarse desert stoneware, open pit reduction firing
products.shortDescription: One-of-a-kind sculptural vessel with natural fire markings and raw tactile texture.
products.description: Crafted by hand using ancestral coil techniques. The surface is left unglazed to celebrate the authentic texture and warmth of UAE terracotta clays.

products.name: Pillar Fluted Travertine Side Table
products.materials: CNC fluted honed travertine with weighted solid base
products.shortDescription: Fluted architectural column side table designed for pairing with low lounge chairs.
products.description: Drawing inspiration from classical architectural colonnades, the Pillar side table features vertical ribbing carved with exacting stone milling machines.

products.name: Kite Sculptural Paper Floor Lamp
products.materials: Handmade washi mulberry paper, cast iron tripod base, bamboo ribs
products.shortDescription: Lantern-inspired sculptural standing luminaire that diffuses serene illumination.
products.description: Constructed with traditional Japanese paper-stretching methods over lightweight bamboo armatures, supported by a heavy cast iron tripod.

specs.Packaging: Flat packed with quick tool-free setup

products.name: Brutalist Stone & Leather Daybed
products.arabicName: سرير النهار الحجري مع جلد الجمل
products.materials: Solid carved fossil limestone plinth, vegetable-tanned full-grain leather bolster
products.shortDescription: Monolithic stone foundation elevated with hand-stitched leather cushion and brass tether.
products.description: An architectural dialogue between the raw permanence of stone and the supple warmth of patinated leather. Perfectly suited as a room divider or gallery bench.

editorialStories.title: Tactile Sanctuary
editorialStories.subtitle: The Philosophy of Understated Living
editorialStories.description: Quiet luxury is born when honest materials—honed travertine, porous terracotta, and heavy bouclé—are stripped of ornamentation and celebrated for their raw tactile form.

editorialStories.title: Bespoke & Commercial Trade
editorialStories.subtitle: For Architects & Interior Designers
editorialStories.description: We collaborate with leading architectural firms and private clients across the UAE and GCC to engineer bespoke dimensions, custom upholstery, and whole-villa furniture collections.
